ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.
   D. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

4. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   B. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in.
   C. Use Belief in to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings able to:.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Enlightened Beings able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Enlightened Beings able to: has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Names of Scriptures able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures able to:.
   D. Say Names of Scriptures able to: has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   B. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Manners of? (1 mark)
   A. Say Manners of has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Manners of.
   C. Use Manners of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Manners of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.
   B. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.
   D. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.

12. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Names of Scriptures able to: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
